assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organizing principle of the cell is a genuinely new concept of molecular organisation, reducing a messy cellular phenomenon to polymer physics and phase behaviour. It reframed how membraneless compartments (P granules, nucleoli, stress granules) are understood and brought thermodynamics of multivalent, low-complexity assemblies into cell biology.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne made the founding observation of liquid-like P granules and the quantitative framework; Rosen's multivalent-protein phase transition work supplied the molecular-mechanistic and thermodynamic basis. Pappu and Mittag are strong contributors on sequence-encoded driving forces, but a three-person prize is cleanest. Priority among the three is not fully settled.
assessment.maturity: Concept is broadly confirmed across many systems and labs, and has had large impact. The in vivo relevance and functional meaning of condensates in specific cases remains debated, so some of the field is still maturing, though the core principle is solid.
uncertainties: Ongoing debate on which cellular condensates are true equilibrium phases versus other assemblies
Whether the work is best viewed as chemistry or cell biology
Exclusion of Pappu and Mittag from a three-person split; I am relying on memory for contribution details

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a soft-matter and lipid self-assembly solution to delivering fragile nucleic acids; the pKa-tuned ionizable lipid design, microfluidic mixing and phase behaviour of lipid-nucleic acid assemblies enabled siRNA drugs and mRNA vaccines at global scale. Impact is exceptional and the physical chemistry of lipid assembly is central.
assessment.attribution: Cullis, Madden and Hope are the foundational Vancouver contributors to the lipid nanoparticle and ionizable-lipid systems; Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan also contributed substantially to lipid design and formulation. Credit is spread across a long chain of developments and a three-person selection requires judgement about which steps were decisive.
assessment.maturity: Validated clinically at massive scale (siRNA therapy, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines). Timing is strong, although mRNA vaccine science already received a Medicine prize in 2023, which may bear on how the committee frames the chemistry contribution.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize for mRNA modification
Patent and priority disputes among delivery groups
Which formulation steps are the decisive chemical discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Energy-landscape theory with the folding funnel gave a general physical-chemical principle for how proteins fold, explaining the Levinthal paradox, with experimental mapping of folding pathways and transition states. It is a prime example of reducing a complex biological problem to thermodynamics and statistical mechanics.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic are the principal architects of the funnel and minimal frustration principle; Fersht provided the experimental protein-engineering (phi-value) analysis of folding transition states. Bryngelson and Dill are also credited and could reasonably be recognized, so allocation is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Decades of confirmation and now embedded in structure prediction and design discussions. Recognition is arguably overdue rather than premature, although the 2024 prize for structure prediction touched adjacent territory.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2024 prize on protein structure prediction and design
Fair split between theorists (Wolynes, Onuchic, Dill) and experimentalist Fersht
Contested priority among Bryngelson, Dill and Wolynes

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers turned a defect-tolerant, solution-processed semiconductor family into high-efficiency photovoltaics in little over a decade. The materials chemistry, crystal-structure tolerance and ionic-electronic behaviour are rich, and the impact on energy research has been very large.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first reported perovskite-sensitized cells; Park and Seok established solid-state high-efficiency devices; Snaith's work on meso-superstructured and planar devices drove the field's rise; Grätzel and Kanatzidis also contributed. The set is crowded and any three leaves out important people.
assessment.maturity: Efficiencies are independently confirmed and widely reproduced, but long-term stability and commercial deployment are unresolved, making the prize somewhat early from a lasting-impact view.
uncertainties: Operational stability and lead toxicity unresolved
Crowded credit and a contentious allocation among six names
Whether the discovery is chemistry or physics/energy engineering

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts one base to another without double-strand breaks using engineered deaminases fused to a Cas variant. It is a clear, original chemical-biology concept, now entering the clinic, and the directed evolution of an adenine deaminase acting on DNA was a notable chemical achievement.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the conceptual and experimental development, with Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor) as the first authors of the decisive papers. Nishida and Kondo made a related cytidine-deaminase approach. Liu alone is clearly central, so attribution is feasible but could be solo or shared.
assessment.maturity: Independent confirmation is extensive and first clinical results have appeared. Genome editing was recognized in 2020 so timing may be debated, but the chemical logic is distinct.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2020 CRISPR prize
Whether trainees or Liu alone should be credited
Long-term clinical safety and efficacy outcomes still emerging

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics introduced ab initio dynamics with electronic structure and nuclear motion treated together, enabling first-principles simulation of liquids, interfaces and reactions. It created the field of ab initio MD and informs my interest in water, interfaces and condensed-phase thermodynamics.
assessment.attribution: Attribution is unusually clean: the 1985 paper by two authors is the decisive contribution, so a two-person prize is natural.
assessment.maturity: Long and broad confirmation, thousands of applications, and arguably overdue. Maturity is very high.
uncertainties: Already substantial recognition in physics and chemistry prizes outside the Nobel; whether the committee views it as methods work of sufficient chemical consequence
Parrinello's other methods (metadynamics, machine-learned potentials) may complicate how the prize is framed

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation via PROTACs and molecular glues introduced a new chemical modality that rewires the ubiquitin system to remove disease proteins, with a clear mechanistic concept and clinical translation. It extends induced proximity beyond occupancy-driven pharmacology.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies founded the PROTAC concept; Ciulli advanced VHL ligands and structural mechanism; the glue arm (Handa, Ito, Gray, Sakamoto and others) is also substantial. Compound discovery with differing contributions that may need separate recognition.
assessment.maturity: Clinical trials of degraders are ongoing without a fully approved PROTAC yet, which suggests the prize may be slightly early; the molecular glue lineage via thalidomide is more mature.
uncertainties: No approved PROTAC drug yet
Fair division between PROTAC and glue-degrader strands
Chemistry versus pharmacology framing

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native mass spectrometry brought intact non-covalent protein assemblies, including membrane protein-lipid complexes, into the gas phase for measuring stoichiometry and interactions. As a lipid-protein person I value its role in showing specific lipid binding to membrane proteins and in probing assembly thermodynamics.
assessment.attribution: Robinson's group drove the application to large complexes and membrane proteins; Heck and Chait contributed major methodological and applied advances; Loo and Gross also have credit. The gas-phase relevance to solution structure, and credit among ESI pioneers, call for care.
assessment.maturity: Well established and independently used across many labs; recognition is reasonably timely, though a mass spectrometry prize was given in 2002 for ESI and MALDI.
uncertainties: Previous recognition of ESI with the 2002 prize
Debate on gas-phase structure fidelity to solution
Choice among five credited names
